convertedFacts.logicSummary:
Inputs:
- a: "Side a", number, starts at 3, 1 to 8, step 0.1, written a
- b: "Side b", number, starts at 4, 1 to 8, step 0.1, written b
Outputs:
- c: "Hypotenuse", number, written c = sqrt(a^2 + b^2)
convertedFacts.outline:
Pythagoras' theorem: The square on the long side equals the squares on the other two: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.
- figure #block-0 ref triangel "The squares on the sides"
- equation #block-1 ref c
  c = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}
- section #block-2 "Change the sides"
  - slider #block-2-0 ref a
  - slider #block-2-1 ref b
- hero #block-3 ref c
- paragraph #block-4
  The long side is {c} when the others are {a} and {b}.
figure triangle:
  point C = (0, 0) "C"
  point B = (a, 0) "B"
  point A = (0, b) "A"
  point A = (1, 1) "again"
  point P = (Bx, -a)
  point Q = (0, -a)
  point R = (-b, A.y)
  point S = (-b, )
  point T = (B_x + A.Y, B.x)
  point U = (A.y, A.y + B.x)
  point Far = (sqrt(-a), 0) "nowhere"
  point Loop = (Loop.x + 1, 0)
  point Bad = (zebra, 0)
  polygon ABC main
  polygon C, B, P, Q "$a^2$" contrast
  polygon C, A, R, S "$b^2$" contrast
  square B, A, C "$c^2$" main
  rightAngle B, C, A plain
  segment B, A "c = {c} {nothing}" main
  segment B, Z "broken" plain
  circle C radius radius of it plain
  circle C radius c - 10 plain
  arc C radius 1 from 0° to atan2(b, a) * 180 / pi° "θ" plain
  arc C radius 1 from 45° to 45° plain
  angle A, B, C "β" plain
  text C "  " plain
  arrow C, Far plain
  angle A, B plain
